ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a large triangle HFK, with vertex H at the top, F at the lower left, and K at the lower right. Point G is located on side HF, point J is located on side HK, and segment GJ crosses the interior of the triangle and is in the same direction as the base FK, indicating that GJ \parallel FK is required. Reasoning: Because GJ \parallel FK, the small triangle HGJ and the large triangle HFK are similar. It is known that HG = 6 and GF = 12, so HF = HG + GF = 6 + 12 = 18. It is known that HJ = 8 and JK = x - 4, so HK = HJ + JK = 8 + (x - 4) = x + 4. From corresponding sides of similar triangles being proportional, HG/HF = HJ/HK, therefore 6/18 = 8/(x + 4). Simplifying gives 1/3 = 8/(x + 4), so x + 4 = 24, x = 20.

method.method_draft: From the image, identify a large triangle HFK with G on side HF and J on side HK, and the segment GJ drawn inside parallel to base FK. From the text, use GF = 12, HG = 6, HJ = 8, and JK = x - 4. Since GJ is parallel to FK, triangle HGJ is similar to triangle HFK. Compute HF = HG + GF = 18 and HK = HJ + JK = 8 + (x - 4) = x + 4. Set the similarity ratio HG/HF = HJ/HK, so 6/18 = 8/(x + 4), then solve for x.

method.method_draft: From the image, view GJ as a segment joining the two sides FH and HK of triangle FHK, splitting those sides into upper parts HG and HJ and lower parts GF and JK. From the text, use HG = 6, GF = 12, HJ = 8, and JK = x - 4. Because GJ is parallel to FK, the side-splitter theorem gives HG/GF = HJ/JK. Substitute 6/12 = 8/(x - 4), solve x - 4 = 16, and get x = 20.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个大三角形 FHK，H 在顶部，F 在左下方，K 在右下方。点 G 位于左边 FH 上，点 J 位于右边 HK 上，线段 GJ 横向连接两边，并与底边 FK 方向一致。推理：把 GJ 看作连接三角形 FHK 两边 FH 和 HK 的线段。已知 HG = 6，GF = 12，HJ = 8，JK = x - 4。若 GJ ∥ FK，则由平行线分线段成比例定理，有 HG/GF = HJ/JK。代入得 6/12 = 8/(x - 4)。化简 1/2 = 8/(x - 4)，所以 x - 4 = 16，得到 x = 20。
